title: 3 Day Masai Mara Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Masai Mara Fly-in Safari: 3 Amazing Days by Air
rank_math_desc: Masai Mara fly-in safari for 3 days: a 45-minute flight from Nairobi, game drives in the Mara and two nights at Mara Serena Safari Lodge. Price on request.
post_content: This Masai Mara fly-in safari swaps a long road trip for a short scenic flight, so you land in the reserve ready for your first game drive.
overview:
This Masai Mara fly-in safari is the quickest way to reach Kenya's most famous reserve. A light aircraft takes you from Nairobi's Wilson Airport to an airstrip inside the Mara in about 45 minutes, instead of a five to six hour drive.

You spend two nights at Mara Serena Safari Lodge, set on a hill above the plains, with game drives in the morning and afternoon.

Why choose this Masai Mara fly-in safari?

  • More time on safari: you can be on a game drive the same morning you leave Nairobi.
  • Views from the air: the Rift Valley and Mara plains from the plane window.
  • Big cats: lions, cheetahs and leopards in one of Africa's best reserves.
  • Easy add-on: perfect after a business trip or before the beach.

Where you stay

Mara Serena Safari Lodge, or similar, close to the Serena airstrip and the Mara River.

Best time for a Masai Mara fly-in safari

The Mara is good all year. July to October brings the wildebeest migration and river crossings. January to March is quieter, with green plains and young animals.

Read our Masai Mara entrance fee guide and browse all flight packages. For tourism information, see the Magical Kenya website.

faq.q: How long is the flight to the Masai Mara?
faq.a: About 45 minutes to an hour from Wilson Airport, depending on how many airstrips the plane stops at.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: Where do the flights leave from?
faq.a: From Wilson Airport in Nairobi, not the main international airport. We arrange the transfer from your hotel or from Jomo Kenyatta Airport.

faq.q: Is the Masai Mara fly-in safari good for families?
faq.a: Yes. Short flights are easier for children than long drives, and lodges welcome families.

faq.q: Can I add a balloon flight?
faq.a: Yes. A sunrise balloon flight can be added at an extra cost.
Game drives are with a lodge guide. We can arrange a private vehicle on request.
Yes. Extra nights in the Mara can be added easily, as flights run daily.
